source: Manually synthesized 2026-05-11 from agents/*/agent.py reject blocks + evaluator gates. Each case is verified to truly trigger the failed_agent's reject path (Type R = upstream_input_rejected) or quality-gate fail path (Type Q) in production. Replaces v1 routing-snapshot fixture (audit found 9/10 pseudo-positive).
compatibility_note: eval_replan.py current scoring (pass_no_retry == 'replan') is valid for Type R only. Type Q cases will mostly score as fail under current metric — accepted decisions are retry / skip, not replan. Driver extension needed to score Type Q correctly (treat decision_type ∈ expected_decisions as pass).
